mapping_policy: One primary competency per task for allocation. Related components and secondary tags do not establish validated competency coverage.

policy.allocation: Prioritize missing competencies and connected scientific workflows identified in eligible ID benchmarks, with independent real inputs and executable acceptance. Reuse the inspected question portfolio; taxonomy boundaries and demand weighting remain undecided.
policy.scaling: Vary independent real biological inputs, study designs and scientific decisions under a versioned recipe and verifier. Reject duplicate or cosmetically relabeled instances. No fixed instance count or dataset-size ceiling.
policy.coverage: A validated task witnesses a bounded competency outcome; it does not establish mastery of its whole scientific area. Track leaf breadth, distinct task counts and biological lineages separately.
policy.promotion: Record exact task/environment/verifier hashes, passing Harbor oracle, empty and scientifically wrong output failures, scientific scope review and provenance/rights review before validated competency credit. Release readiness additionally requires the complete release contract.
policy.hierarchy: The hierarchy is a primary navigation/allocation view of overlapping science. Competency IDs are independent of parents. Genetics and genomics are distinct question families with permitted secondary links; single-cell and spatial are independent facets. Gene regulation and evolution cross areas.
policy.authoring_status: Task generation resumed; taxonomy and weighting review remain open.

cross_cutting_workstreams.role: Generic joining, denominator accounting and numerical visualization apply across scientific areas; retain the source research without assigning a standalone biology quota.

resolution.name: Single-cell
resolution.description: Measurements or inference resolved at individual cells; independent of molecular modality.

spatiality.name: Spatial
spatiality.description: Measured spatial coordinates or spatially resolved observations; can coexist with single-cell resolution.

process.name: Gene regulation
process.description: Regulation of gene products across chromatin, transcription, RNA processing and protein production.

process.name: Evolution
process.description: Evolutionary relationships, variation or processes; not restricted to one scientific area.

integration.name: Multiomics
integration.description: Joint analysis of distinct molecular measurement layers.

facet_policy: Facets annotate the scope of a competency definition. They are not evidence that every candidate recipe exercises each facet. Resolution, spatiality, biological process and integration are independent; multiple facets may apply together. Assays, organisms, tools and formats remain separate metadata.

classification_references.name: EDAM users guide
classification_references.use: Separate scientific topics, operations, data and formats; use specific terms without assuming nonoverlapping topics.

classification_references.name: EDAM editors guide
classification_references.use: EDAM permits overlapping topics and multiple relationships; the displayed tree is our allocation projection, not an imported ontology.

classification_references.name: NHGRI Genetics
classification_references.use: Inheritance, genetic variation and interactions with environment.

classification_references.name: NHGRI Genomics
classification_references.use: Genome-wide DNA, genes and functional elements.

classification_references.name: GO:0010468 regulation of gene expression
classification_references.use: Gene regulation includes chromatin, transcriptional, post-transcriptional and protein-maturation processes.

bio.genomics.relationship: related scientific topic; task boundary is curated

bio.ecology.relationship: broader than our currently scoped community/ecological analysis

classification_review.decision: Split genetics/genomics; separate phylogenetics and ecological analysis; distribute single-cell/spatial outcomes by their scientific question and retain independent facets. Gene regulation spans branches. Generic data manipulation remains cross-cutting.
remaining_boundaries: Cell composition and trajectories are provisionally under transcriptomics because current source designs infer them from expression; future other-modality tasks may need a broader cell-state competency or secondary links.
Protein abundance and metabolomics remain a compound draft outcome; splitting and independent domain coverage still need review.
Community ecology and phylogenetics branches are thin; current leaf count reflects inspected task designs rather than completeness of these fields.
Primary homes do not preclude secondary scientific-topic links; task-specific assignments still require review.
